content: Azure Network Watcher rule recommendation is now in public preview, helping you proactively identify opportunities to improve network security based on observed network traffic. With this capability, you can use Traffic Analytics insights to identify network security rules that may be overly permissive or no longer required. Rule recommendation analyzes observed traffic patterns and provides actionable recommendations to help you strengthen your network security posture while maintaining required connectivity. You can review recommendations, drill down into the supporting traffic insights, and use this context to make informed decisions before updating your network security rules. Learn more.
